pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-segments/src/case.rs:40 validate_case, which runs from CaseStore::load and stage, never requires hexes to start fogged and ungraded. A case file whose hex is already face-up at DOC with no primary source passes every check, because the DOC rule only fires on the reveal op. The owner's content-hash approval is the only remaining check.

techniques.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-segments/src/runtime.rs:1943 The DOC rule judges only grades set through the sanctioned reveal op. A grade written straight into case.json is never judged: an inert branch. The daemon's casework writes fog: true, but nothing fences the record.

crates/shadowrunr-segments/src/runtime.rs:3360 A face-up hex with no grade gets no ALLEGED marker, so a missing grade reads like DOC (stated as fact). Reachable only through a case file with fog false and no grade.
crates/shadowrunr-segments/src/evidence.rs:216 Matches the parsed host, not a substring. Userinfo, query and path occurrences of sec.gov do not count.
crates/shadowrunr-segments/src/evidence.rs:82 A URL the parser cannot read is never a primary source: it fails closed instead of passing.
crates/shadowrunr-segments/src/evidence.rs:150 An empty research allowlist is a load error, not an empty rule set. Tests also feed known-bad URLs (e.g. evidence.rs:270).
crates/shadowrunr-segments/src/cases.rs:453 The refusal names remedies that exist in the same store: CaseStore::retract, or a new id.
crates/shadowrunr-segments/src/cases.rs:204 The owner's approval for live use is bound to the exact content hash, recomputed from disk. Any change to the content voids it.
